title: cogitator.yml
description: The cogitator dbt language server's per-project configuration file. Every section except 'startup:' hot-reloads; 'startup:' keys apply only via --config at launch.

artifact_mib.description: target/ artifact files past this size are skipped. (MiB)

compiled_sql_mib.description: dbt.compiledSql wire cap; bigger files answer uri-only. (MiB)

lint.description: Opt-in style diagnostics; every check defaults to off.

dead_models.description: Hint on models nothing downstream uses. (bool)

select_star.description: Warn on SELECT * outside staging models. (bool)

trailing_comma.description: Warn on trailing commas the dialect rejects. (bool)

unaliased_columns.description: Warn on bare columns in multi-relation FROM/JOINs. (bool)

undocumented_columns.description: Hint on produced columns missing from the schema YAML. (bool)

log.description: What reaches the editor's log view (window/logMessage).

client_level.description: Verbosity of the editor-visible log stream; $/setTrace adjusts it too (last writer wins). (off|error|warn|info|debug)

profiles.description: dbt profiles overrides — hot: editing these re-resolves the active profile/target.

allow.description: Profiles readable besides the project's own (like --profiles-allow). ([names])

profile.description: Active profile override; empty means the project's own. (name)

startup.description: Launch-only keys (install-once subsystems); honored via --config, a restart applies changes.

debug.description: Plain-text logging to log.txt beside the executable. (bool)

fusion.description: dbt Fusion binary path enabling compile diagnostics. (path)

otlp.description: OTLP trace/metric export endpoint; empty uses the SDK default. (url)

columns.description: Complete source columns from the warehouse when the YAML has none. (bool)
